pages.text: Add ectoplasm ice cubes, sweet berries, and a little sugar, and you get this delicious sundae that glows with a deep blue light.$(br)For the consumer:$(li)2 minutes of Fortunate$(li)1 minute 30 seconds of Regeneration$(li)1 minute 30 seconds of Chill Hide$(li)Also restores 300 Soul Energy.$(br)“Turn ectoplasm — drizzled with slimeball — into the flavor of sweet berries!”
